_comment: The formation compresses in a confined space (the game designer's decision 2026-11-21: 'the whole squad must enter' a ~5 m2 khrushchevka flat hall and the 2.5 m gable-vestibule corridors). Read by FormationConfinedTuning (C++, Source/CodexTactics/Public/Formation/FormationConfinedRules.h - the full rule). When the leader arrives (his destination within arrive_m, within level_dz_cm of his floor) or stands, probe_rays navmesh rays of probe_m round the destination measure the pocket; it is confined when their median free distance <= confined_median_m (open ground never is - the formation there is unchanged; in a confined pocket the automatic wall layout is skipped). A follower's slot outside the pocket (radius max(median, min_radius_cm), wall_margin_cm short of the free distance), on the leader's remaining way or on the entry line (way_half_width_cm round them) moves to a place inside it on the probe rays (rings from min_spacing_cm in ring_step_cm steps and 2 x min_spacing_cm), min_spacing_cm from the leader and each other, reached on a straight line keeping pass_clear_cm from the places given out, never past the leader in a hall narrower than 2 x pass_free_cm; cost = his walk - depth_weight x the distance from the entry point (the first man in goes deepest); walking to his place a follower faces his walk until face_walk_cm from it. While compressed the followers' crowd separation and obstacle avoidance are off (Codex.Formation.ConfinedCrowd 1 keeps them). Lead review 2026-11-22: a place must be seen from the entry point on a clear navmesh line whose samples (jamb_sample_cm apart) keep jamb_clear_cm from the navmesh edge (with its 35 cm agent erosion more than the 40 cm capsule: no place round a door jamb's corner), and a follower already inside needs his own clear navmesh line to it. gap_factor: a ray longer than gap_factor x both neighbours (a door seen through by one ray) reaches only as far as its shorter neighbour, unless the neighbours are themselves longer than gap_factor x the median (a corridor's axis). Lead review round 2: no place beyond a throat on the line from the centre (the navmesh edge nearer than throat_clear_cm on the way - a door - while the centre is roomier), and a follower keeps the place he was given while it stays valid. recenter_cm / refresh_s: a held pocket is probed again. Console Codex.Formation.Confined -1 = this file, 0 = off (A/B), 1 = on.
_comment_entry_queue: Entry order 2026-11-22 (the STUCK legs: a follower held at the door by his team-mate's body on a place by the door). entry_queue 1 = the depth queue: the squad's navmesh way in (the leader's path to the pocket centre) gives an inside entry point (the first point of its last run inside the pocket and the room, sampled every entry_step_cm) and an outside one entry_back_cm back along it (the door side: the jamb line test and the entry line); places rank by their distance from the inside point, the man first through the door (navmesh way to the inside point; neighbours flip only past queue_hysteresis_cm) takes the deepest, the next the next, a later place never on an earlier man's way in; a man through the door keeps his place; a man standing (below block_speed_cm_s for block_s) with a team-mate within block_radius_cm on his way swaps places with him (not again for block_cooldown_s). 0 = the round-3 cost rule (A/B; console Codex.Formation.ConfinedQueue).
_comment_body_clear: body_clear_cm: a follower whose straight way to his confined place passes a standing body (the leader, a team-mate) closer than this (head on, not a graze the capsules slide past) walks first to a step-round point beside it (min_spacing_cm + 5 out, on the way's side, the other side when that is off the navmesh; the navmesh ignores bodies and the followers' crowd avoidance is off while compressed). 0 = off.
_comment_door_mouth: door_mouth_cm (2026-11-22, the walk smoke's remaining STUCK hall legs): the ground within this of the inside entry point is the way in of every man behind. A man standing in it is not through the door yet (dealt from there - his own straight navmesh line to every place cut by the jamb - he took the entry point itself and stood in the door for good, the man behind him on the landing); he is dealt from the inside entry point like the men outside. A place in it goes only to the last man of the queue. 0 = off.
_comment_tight: tight_min_share (2026-11-22, the 1-body hall legs: S04 / S10 storey-1 halls hold the leader + one man): with no spaced place left, a follower takes the place farthest from everyone only if it keeps this share of min_spacing_cm, else he keeps his formation slot and waits at the door instead of squeezing 40 cm from a team-mate and pushing (STUCK). 0.5 = the rule before. Worker A/B on the dressed showcase: flat entries 81 -> 82 / 84, S04 hall: STUCK pushing -> waits outside.
_comment_leader_room: leader_room_cm (2026-11-22, the same STUCK legs): the leader standing at his click just inside a hall door (85 cm in, the 2.3 m hall's middle) leaves no body's width between himself and the jambs - the first man in pushed into him from the door mouth and the man behind waited on the landing. When a follower near the door (within 2 x max(door_mouth_cm, min_spacing_cm) of the inside entry point) has the standing leader first on his way and no side to step round him, the leader steps straight away from the inside entry point until leader_room_cm from it, at most leader_room_max_cm (he stays by his click), on the navmesh - once per player order. 0 = off.
